name: Improved Duck and Cover [Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
Your ability to protect your ally from damage extends to area attacks.

Prerequisite(s): Duck and Cover.

Benefit(s): Whenever you use Duck and Cover, your ally is treated as having evasion or improved evasion if they already have evasion. If your ally’s saving throw roll succeeds, half of the damage they would have taken is transferred to you. (This damage is not reduced by the ally’s evasion or improved evasion.)
